simple.summary: יָחִיל (yâchîyl) means expectant First listed occurrence: Lam 3 26.

definitions.full: H3175. yachil יָחִיל adjective verb. waiting , so Thes SS Buhl, but very dubious, — only לְ וְדוּמָם וְיָחִיל טוֺב Lam 3:26 good is it that one be waiting and that silently (but see דוּמָם ) for the salvation of ׳י ; construct. with ו and adjective hardly possibly; Ew Ke Lohr Kö ii. 407 and others regard as verb (from חול ); read perhaps וְיֹחִיל Hiph`il Imperfect from יחל (compare 3:24 ).
